settings.visualStyle: Battle of Moscow winter 1941 historical reenactment, snow-covered forests and villages, frozen trenches, visible breath, subdued blue-grey wartime film palette, 35mm field-camera grain, realistic Soviet winter uniforms and equipment, non-graphic combat, no modern objects.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds following one fictional Soviet rifleman as a continuity anchor through forest approach, frozen trench defense, shelling, village movement, a brief human recovery beat and a small counter-move. No dialogue or narrator. One main action and one camera movement per scene.
settings.customVisualStyle: Cold, tactile winter field-film look: ice on wood and metal, snow dust on uniforms, breath vapor, pale sky, blue dusk, restrained muzzle flashes and sparse camera shake.

movie.plotDetails: Fictional composite Soviet rifleman used only for visual continuity within a historically plausible winter battlefield.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create an immersive two-minute winter battlefield reenactment near Moscow in late 1941. Follow one fictional Soviet rifleman through snow forest, frozen trench, artillery pressure, a village edge, a short lull and renewed defensive movement. Emphasize cold, breathing, numb hands, frozen ground and visibility. Avoid graphic injury, constant action and heroic posing. No dialogue or narration.
movie.storySummary: A Soviet rifleman moves through a snow-covered forest into a frozen defensive line. Shelling drives the men low, the unit answers from the trench, then shifts through trees and a nearby village. A brief pause gives the soldiers a moment to adjust gear and warm their hands before returning to the line. Night and dawn pass over the same positions, and the episode ends with the defense still holding in the cold.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP04 — Moscow 1941: Winter Resistance

scenes.title: Frozen Dawn
scenes.description: A Soviet infantry section trudges through a snow-covered pine track at first light.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman walks with shoulders hunched against the cold while fresh snow compresses under his boots.
scenes.imageDescription: Winter 1941 near Moscow, pale dawn, snow-laden pines, Soviet infantry in historically plausible winter uniforms, same rifleman with snow on shoulders and rifle carried low, visible breath, muted 35mm color.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear three-quarter handheld tracking through snow, natural body sway. Audio: snow crunch, fabric, breath, wind, distant artillery. No speech.

scenes.title: Frozen Trench
scenes.description: The section arrives at a shallow trench cut into frozen ground.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman drops into the trench, rests one glove on icy timber and peers over the snow lip.
scenes.imageDescription: Shallow snowy trench, ice-coated timber, sandbags, Soviet defenders, same rifleman with frost on gloves and visible breath.
scenes.videoPrompt: Descend with the soldier into trench level, then push gently toward the parapet. Audio: boots, ice scrape, breath, wind.

scenes.title: Shells in the Snow
scenes.description: Artillery impacts farther along the defensive line throw snow into the air.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman ducks as snow showers over the trench but remains uninjured.
scenes.imageDescription: Frozen trench, white snow plume from nearby shell impact, soldiers low in cover, no gore, period equipment.
scenes.videoPrompt: One impact-driven shake followed by muffled recovery at low height. Audio: boom, snow debris, momentary dull ringing, breathing.

scenes.title: Answer Through Frost
scenes.description: The defenders return fire toward a distant treeline.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman raises his rifle above the parapet and fires controlled shots before lowering again.
scenes.imageDescription: Soviet winter rifleman firing from trench, frosted weapon metal, distant dark trees, smoke wisps, no enemy close in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low over-shoulder shot with weapon offset, brief firing only. Audio: rifle reports, echo, wind, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Through the Pines
scenes.description: A small group leaves the trench to reinforce a nearby forest position.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman crouch-runs between pines using trunks as cover.
scenes.imageDescription: Snow forest, dark trunks, low fog, Soviet soldiers moving between trees, snow kicked from boots.
scenes.videoPrompt: Lateral handheld move weaving behind trunks. Audio: snow crunch, branches, breath, distant gunfire.

scenes.title: Village Fence
scenes.description: The unit reaches a frozen village edge and takes cover behind a wooden fence and log wall.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman kneels behind a snow-covered fence while scanning the lane beyond.
scenes.imageDescription: Frozen log houses, wooden fence, smoke from chimneys and battlefield haze, soldier in cover, subdued winter colors.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium pan along the fence line ending on the rifleman. Audio: wind, creaking wood, distant shots.

scenes.title: Across the Icy Lane
scenes.description: The section makes a short move between buildings under pressure.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman runs across an icy lane and stops behind the corner of a log house.
scenes.imageDescription: Snowy village lane, packed ice, log walls, drifting smoke, same soldier moving quickly with rifle held low.
scenes.videoPrompt: One short dash across the lane ending hard at cover. Audio: boots sliding on ice, gear, distant fire.

scenes.title: A Minute of Snow
scenes.description: The firing fades for a moment and snow falls quietly around the position.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman leans against the log wall, flexes stiff fingers inside his gloves and catches his breath.
scenes.imageDescription: Quiet village corner, soft snow falling, same rifleman exhausted, rifle resting against wall edge, no fighting nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still close shot on gloves and breath, subtle tilt to face. Audio: wind, snow, breathing, very distant artillery.

scenes.title: Shared Scarf
scenes.description: A nearby comrade helps tighten the rifleman’s scarf and shoulder strap before they move again.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman stands still as a comrade adjusts the loose scarf and checks the strap.
scenes.imageDescription: Small supportive winter moment, two Soviet soldiers, no dialogue, snow on clothing, damaged village behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle close two-shot with one slow push-in. Audio: fabric, buckle, breath, wind.

scenes.title: Back to the Line
scenes.description: The section returns to the snowy trench as afternoon light dims.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman descends into the same trench and takes his earlier position.
scenes.imageDescription: Same trench with deeper boot marks and more churned snow, soldier returning with same gear and accumulated frost.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear tracking into trench, matching Scene 2 location geometry. Audio: snow, gear, wind, distant battle.

scenes.title: Blue Dusk Flashes
scenes.description: Dusk turns the snow blue-grey as distant muzzle flashes flicker across the treeline.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman watches from low cover without firing during this beat.
scenes.imageDescription: Blue dusk snow trench, dark forest horizon, small distant flashes, rifleman silhouette with breath vapor.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static near-still shot from trench level. Audio: wind, distant intermittent fire, breathing.

scenes.title: Night Listening Post
scenes.description: The rifleman stands among dark trees listening for movement beyond the line.
scenes.actionDescription: He remains nearly still beside a pine trunk, rifle ready but lowered.
scenes.imageDescription: Night snow forest, low visibility, faint sky glow, soldier beside pine, no visible enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push through branches toward the still soldier. Audio: wind, branch creak, distant dull battle, breath.

scenes.title: First Light Countermove
scenes.description: At dawn the section advances a short distance through fresh snow.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman follows comrades through untouched snow beyond the previous tree line.
scenes.imageDescription: Pale dawn, fresh snow, Soviet infantry moving cautiously through forest, accumulated fatigue and frost.
scenes.videoPrompt: Forward handheld move through ankle-deep snow. Audio: snow crunch, breath, equipment, distant guns.

scenes.title: Village Still Standing
scenes.description: From the forest edge the rifleman looks back at the battered but occupied village.
scenes.actionDescription: He pauses and studies smoke rising from the village roofs before turning forward.
scenes.imageDescription: Damaged snowy village under pale morning sky, light smoke, soldier foreground profile, no active combat nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow panoramic sweep from village to the rifleman. Audio: wind, distant artillery, no close gunfire.

scenes.title: Winter Resistance
scenes.description: The episode ends with the rifleman returning to the defensive line as wind blows loose snow across the trench.
scenes.actionDescription: He settles into the trench and looks out over the snow-covered field.
scenes.imageDescription: Final wide trench image, windblown snow, exhausted Soviet defenders, rifleman in same position, cold horizon, no victory pose.
scenes.videoPrompt: Long closing hold with subtle handheld drift. Audio: wind, breathing, distant artillery, low restrained score tail.
